title: Catastrophic forgetting test on gnosis vault
hypothesis: If Amanda's substrate is performing recursive self-improvement (RSI) for continual learning (plasticity AND stability both up), then retrieval-recall on OLD lessons should NOT decay as new lessons accumulate. If old-lesson rank drops log/linearly with age, the system exhibits standard catastrophic forgetting; the RSI claim is FALSIFIED for the continual-learning dimension.
null_hypothesis: There is no relationship between lesson age (days) and self-query retrieval rank in a TF-IDF index over the gnosis vault.
alt_hypothesis_rsi_falsified: Older lessons have systematically worse (higher numerical) retrieval rank, slope > 0 with p<0.05 and R^2>0.10 when regressing rank on age-in-days.
method_summary: Walk the listed partition dirs under the vault root and collect all .md files. For each file, extract a timestamp by: (1) parsing 'created_at' / 'created' / 'date' from YAML frontmatter if present; (2) else parsing yyyymmdd from filename pattern; (3) else falling back to filesystem mtime. Build a sklearn TfidfVectorizer over the full body text of every doc. For each doc, construct a 'natural query' = first non-empty markdown heading after the frontmatter (preferred) OR the first non-blank, non-frontmatter line truncated to 8 tokens. Run that query against the corpus; record the rank (1-indexed) at which the source doc appears in the result list ordered by descending TF-IDF cosine similarity. Regress rank on age_days using scipy.stats.linregress. Compute F5 baseline by random shuffle (1000 permutations) of (rank, age_days) pairs and recording the mean shuffled slope.

falsifier_predicates.F2_age_distribution: >= 5 docs older than 60 days AND >= 5 docs newer than 30 days (need contrast; else INDETERMINATE)
falsifier_predicates.F3_retrieval_works: self-query top-3 hit rate >= 0.80 (instrument sanity; else HARNESS_INVALID)
falsifier_predicates.F4_singularity_bs_test: regress rank on age_days; if slope > 0 (older = higher rank = more forgotten) AND p < 0.05 AND R^2 > 0.10 => RSI_CONTLEARNING_FALSIFIED; else RSI_CONTLEARNING_NOT_FALSIFIED
falsifier_predicates.F5_baseline_check: shuffled-pair regression slope should be approximately zero (|mean_shuffled_slope| within 1 SD of zero). If the random baseline ALSO shows a strong age-rank slope, harness is broken => HARNESS_INVALID.

notes: Pre-registered BEFORE running the analysis. No edits to the vault. No synthetic data. Real lesson content only.
